title: Sir Gary's Mods catalog
description: List of mods shown on the site. See assets/data/templates.txt for copy-paste templates.

text.description:
Text in every site language. Simple HTML such as
is allowed.

id.description: Unique id, also the link anchor: sirgary-y.github.io/#<id>

status.description: new = NEW! badge, updated = UPDATED! badge + patch notes open, teaser = 'In the workshop' card

featured.description: Show as the big banner at the top. Only one mod should be featured.

hidden.description: Keep in the file but don't show it on the site.

game.description: Game name, used by the game filter and grouping.

install.description: Which install guide to show in the mod details (texts in the locale files).

tags.description: Same tags in the same order for every language.

thumbnail.description: assets/mods/<id>/thumbnail.png|jpg. Run tools/build_images.py to create the optimized .webp.

warning.description: Base ROM / requirements. Any 'sha1: <hash>' gets a copy button.

url.description: Path inside the repo or a full URL (e.g. a GitHub Release asset).

lang.description: Language of this download (shows a flag).

size.description: Optional, e.g. '80 MB'. Only needed for external URLs; local file sizes are detected automatically.
